\title{Mn3Sn: field-free switching}
\begin{abstract}
Field-free switching of Mn3Sn has not been studied.
Here we show two results: fast reversal and a low threshold.
\end{abstract}

\section{Introduction}
The switching mechanism remains unknown.
Dense memory calls for field-free switching at a ratio of 1:2 and by 12:30 each day.

\section{Results: reversal}
To model the switching, we use Eq.~\eqref{eq:two}; the reversal follows Eq.~\eqref{eq:one}.
\begin{equation}
E = 1 \label{eq:one}
\end{equation}
\begin{equation}
F = 2 \label{eq:two}
\end{equation}
